name: Ventana Big Sur
positioning: Alila Ventana Big Sur, a resort on the California coast overlooking the Pacific and surrounded by redwood forest, tailored to adults, with meals included in every stay
best_for: Couples seeking a quiet nature escape on the Big Sur coast
Travelers who want guided hikes, forest bathing and wellness in the redwoods

facts.text: Alila Ventana Big Sur is a resort on the California coast, overlooking the Pacific Ocean and surrounded by redwood forest.
The resort sits 1,200 feet above the Pacific, among meadows and wooded hillsides.
The resort is near Pfeiffer Beach, Bixby Bridge and Point Sur Lighthouse.
Most rooms and suites have wood-burning fireplaces, decks with ocean or forest views and private hot tubs.
Guests can stay in a standalone villa or in one of the resort's glamping sites.
The two-story Big Sur Villa has ocean and forest views, a private deck and a living area with a fireplace.
Rooms mix mid-century and rustic-chic style, with working fireplaces, stone and wood.
Spa Alila combines intuitive traditions from Indonesia with holistic techniques from Europe.
Complimentary seasonal programming includes guided hikes, forest bathing, meditation, wellness classes and nature experiences.
Guests can join a group class at the Ventana beehives.
The Sur House uses fresh ingredients from the resort's organic garden, and its terrace has ocean views.
The Glass House offers private dining with ocean views and a prix fixe menu.

highlights.text: The secluded Mountain Pool sits high atop the resort among towering redwoods, next to Japanese hot baths for communal bathing.
Meadow Pool has views of the ocean and redwood forest, private cabanas and an infinity-edge hot tub.
Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included throughout the stay, from dinner on arrival day to breakfast on departure day.
The Cottage is a standalone villa with a private deck with a hammock, forest canyon views and an outdoor hot tub.
Guests can join a master falconer for an introduction to hawks, falcons and owls.

considerations.text: The resort does not offer amenities, programming or an environment typically suited to guests traveling with children.
Accommodations are limited to a maximum of two guests per room.
Cell reception at the resort is very limited.
